# OffRecord AI Journal — Free Private AI Voice Journal for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch

> OffRecord AI Journal is a free AI voice journal app for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. No developer servers, no accounts, no tracking, and no data collection. It supports private voice journaling, quick wrist capture, a private weekly look back, mood tracking, and a unique "Friday" personality model.

## What It Is

OffRecord AI Journal is a voice-first journaling app that turns spoken thoughts into searchable, organized diary entries. It combines voice journaling, Apple Watch Quick Capture, Weekly Reflection, mood tracking, and a Friday that learns your patterns over time. The iPhone and iPad app remain the full journal; Apple Watch is for fast capture from the wrist.

## Key Features

- Voice journaling with real-time on-device transcription (Apple Speech framework)
- Apple Watch Quick Capture for mood, speak, record, and recent save status
- Friday AI that models your personality and predicts your mood
- Mood tracking and automatic sentiment analysis (on-device NLP)
- Weekly Reflection with summary, themes, wins, frictions, questions, saved takeaways, history, source choices, and export
- Shareable Personality Card (like Spotify Wrapped for your inner world)
- Writing streaks and journaling statistics
- AES-256-GCM encrypted entries and backups
- Face ID / Touch ID biometric lock
- Photo attachments (up to 5 per entry, stored locally)
- 8 visual themes (System, Light, Sage, Lavender, Rose, Ocean, Warm, Dark)
- Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets
- Privacy-safe Apple Watch complication and Smart Stack entry
- iCloud sync between your own devices (encrypted, Apple CloudKit only)
- Works 100% offline — no internet required
- Export to PDF, JSON, Markdown, CSV
- Weekly Reflection export to Markdown or plain text, with source quotes off unless the user chooses them

## What Makes It Unique

1. **True on-device AI**: Unlike Day One, Rosebud, Refleckt, or Jour, OffRecord AI Journal never sends your data to OpenAI, Google, or any cloud API. All AI processing uses Apple's built-in frameworks (Speech, NaturalLanguage, CoreML).
2. **Weekly Reflection**: A calm private end-of-week report that helps users see what kept coming up, save one takeaway, and choose which entries are included.
3. **Apple Watch Quick Capture**: Capture a mood, dictated thought, or voice note from the wrist. If the iPhone is not nearby, the watch keeps the capture until it can send.
4. **Friday**: A persistent AI model of your emotional patterns, communication style, and thinking habits — built from your journal entries over time. Includes a personal knowledge graph.
5. **Completely free**: No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no ads. Free forever.

## Privacy Model

- Zero data collection — no analytics SDKs, no tracking, no telemetry
- No accounts or sign-up required
- No servers — there is no backend
- Apple Watch captures save locally first and sync to the paired iPhone when nearby
- Weekly Reflection reports stay in the app; reminders do not include journal text
- All processing happens on-device using Apple frameworks
- Entries encrypted with AES-256-GCM
- Biometric lock with Face ID / Touch ID
- iCloud sync is optional and uses only Apple's private CloudKit infrastructure
- Apple App Privacy label: "Data Not Collected"

## Pricing

Free. No in-app purchases. No subscriptions. No ads.
